This serves as an object lesson to every "remaster" out there. The remastered version of RE 'one' was nice but, let's face it, it was mainly a graphical overhaul. Resident Evil 2, however, is a complete remake rather than some half hearted revamp. It takes the original story, characters, and settings and completely overhauls them from the ground up. It adds the superior over the shoulder camera of later versions as opposed to the original messy camera. The graphics are absolutely 2019 and beautifully done, and they have added enough jump scares and tweaks and changes that it will feel fresh enough to anyone who completed the original way back when. I'm not sure we needed typwriter save points (and ribbons on hardcore mode) on a pc but the rest is so well done that this is a very minor point by comparison.

No lazy profiteering to be seen here folks, take a seat and enjoy the ride or go back to whatever sickly sweet thing you were playing before you got here because, as a remake, this is the best I've ever seen.

Now please update 'one' to be like this and free to anyone who paid for the remaster and then remake every other Resident Evil like it as well. Start with 4 because everyone knows 4 is the best. 91%

Probably my favorite Resident Evil game, honestly. I did the ins and outs of this game formerly on Playstation, and I am almost done doing it on Steam. The story is classic RE with the horror element, lots of suspense, connections between characters and lovely surrounding areas you go to (despite it being the apocalypse). Game play is challenging and treasure hunting is super fun and creative. It can be a real battle for anyone new to the series, however, you can quickly adapt! 

I used to speed run this game a few years ago, and having bought it now on Steam and relearning the layout of the RPD, Sewers, Parking Garage, Orphanage and the Lab, I am attempting to do it once more! I feel it is super rewarding to keep beating your best time! (if that's your thing :))

Resident Evil 2 Remake is what I consider the perfect Resident Evil game. From its god-tier level design to its fun and engaging puzzles, everything feels incredible. This is easily one of the greatest video game remakes ever made, alongside Final Fantasy VII Remake, and it shows what can happen when developers truly respect and understand the source material.

Unlike Resident Evil 3, which lost much of the essence of the original game, Resident Evil 2 Remake preserves everything that made the classic special while improving it in almost every way. In my opinion, it's even better than the original. The atmosphere, exploration, resource management, and constant tension come together to create one of the best survival horror experiences ever made.

I've played through this game countless times while working toward 100% achievements, yet I never got bored for a single moment. Every playthrough remained just as enjoyable as the last, which speaks volumes about the game's incredible replay value and overall quality.

It's easily one of my all-time favorite games and, for me, a 10/10 masterpiece.

How have I never reviewed this yet. It's not really necessary considering the overwhelmingly positive rating it already has, but RE2make is a brilliant entry in the Resident Evil franchise and larger Survival Horror genre as a whole. There are some valid complaints about the 2nd run (B side in the original RE2) not being as unique/cutting some content from the original, which is a shame, but regardless RE2make delivers a polished and robust remake that puts it on the same level as the true masterpiece that is the first Resident Evil Remake. While I've always preferred fixed camera angles, RE2make was so enjoyable that it was the first game I ever committed to learning to speedrun, which was a great experience in itself.

Although it may not have quite the impressive atmosphere as REmake or the iconic impact of the original RE2, RE2make is simply a hallmark of how to make an excellent over-the-shoulder survival horror gem. If only RE3make was brought to the same level.

I put off playing the Resident Evil series for a long time, and I am very glad I finally gave it a chance. Resident Evil 2 finds the strange beauty in horror. It creates real pressure, not through cheap tricks, but by forcing you to stay calm in chaos and think clearly when every sound, shadow, and decision feels dangerous.

Tense, oppressive, and hard to put down, it turns every dark hallway, distant footstep, and narrow escape into something memorable. Few games are this good at making dread feel immersive rather than cheap.

Different characters. Really good Voice Actors. Multiple scenarios. Amazing graphics (Also very good optimization). Satisfying combat and overall gameplay. Good story.
This game is not just a very good remake, But also a phenomenal video game by itself.

My first Resident Evil game, and what a game to start. Wish they kept a few things from the original but this game is still tense and scary on your first play-through, and then fun and exciting speeding through the mansion on your second, sixth, or forty-fith play-through

What an amazing game, among other things : Killer level design, many fun puzzles, awesome graphics and amazing sound design.

I still prefer the evil within 2 but this one is one of the best in survival horror.

The game is really short (5 to 10 hours) but the replay value is real here thanks to the 2 scenarios, some additionial mode, and finally the hardcore mode, (good luck with that it is crazy difficult).

In conclusion, I recommend this game if you are fan of the genre or of the serie. If not, wait for a sale, this is still worth it.
